values.binNote: No bin row states 13/52/91/130/169 or 0.78/0.65 directly; the wiki derives these by multiplying JhinE.BaseDamage=[20,80,140,200,260] and the 1.2/1.0 ratios from JhinE#TotalDamage by JhinE.ReducedDamagePercent=0.65 (e.g. 20*0.65=13, 1.2*0.65=0.78). The bin has no separate calculation for the reduced-damage case; this value is entirely the wiki's own arithmetic, confirmed exactly by BaseDamage x ReducedDamagePercent.

mechanics.claim: Lotus Traps deal 65% damage against minions as well as against champions and monsters who have been struck by another Lotus Trap in the last 1 second.
mechanics.quote: ''Lotus Traps'' deal 65% damage against {{tip|minions}} as well as against {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} who have been struck by another ''Lotus Trap'' in the last 1 second.

mechanics.claim: Killing an enemy champion summons a free Blooming Lotus Trap under them, without consuming a trap charge.
mechanics.quote: ''Beauty in Death'' does not consume ''Lotus Trap'' charges.

mechanics.claim: The trap arms (becomes stealthed) 1 second after being placed, before it can be triggered.
mechanics.quote: becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after arming over 1 second

mechanics.claim: Blooming Lotus Traps slow enemies within the area for 2 seconds before exploding and dealing their damage.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|slow}} enemies within the area by 35% for 2 seconds before exploding, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies
